job_description:
Job Description

Major Responsibilities
• Lead the analysis, data modeling, technical and functional design of the software project through the software development life cycle (SDLC) utilizing waterfall and agile methodology.
• Design, develop, enhance, debug, and implement interactive web applications and batch software.
• Write test cases and perform functional and integration testing during various phases of the product life cycle.
• Research, test, build, and coordinate the conversion and/or integration of new products based on client requirements.
• Assist in the evaluation and recommendation of application software packages, application integration and testing tools.
• Resolve problems with software and responds to suggestions for improvements and enhancements.
• Interact with subject matter experts and business analysts to resolve any issue related to requirement or user end testing.
• Interact with independent testers to resolve any issue or defect during independent test and verification.

Required Skills
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of an integrated team.
• Strong experience developing web Application utilizing PL/SQL, AJAX, JQuery, CSS and HTML.
• Experience in creating, modifying stored procedures and programming using SQL/PL-SQL.
• Experience in innovative, Java-centric, scalable enterprise custom application design, development, integration, and delivery.
• Highly analytical, possessing critical and creative thinking skills.
• Excellent communication skills with all stakeholders.
• Strong interpersonal skills to maintain effective working relationships with team and customers.
• The following minimum years of experience are required:
• * 6-8 years Oracle, SQL and PL/SQL programming experience
• 6-8 years Java front end application development
• 6-8 years Web Application development and deployment
• 6-8 years API and Batch application development and deployment
• 2-4 years Oracle APEX experience

Optional Skills
• Experience with Oracle BI
• Experience with PERL/Shell programming

Qualifications

Education & Experience
• Bachelor's Degree in a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, technical training or work experience.
• 6-8 years of related experience.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
